author_source: project/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/06_What is TLV, TWA, STEL & IDLH HSE officer Interview Questions/src.py

points.K1: 阈限值：一辈子接触的界线
points.K4: 立即威胁生命和健康的浓度
points.S1: 国内用的三类接触限值

shots.scene: 欣欣站在问答台后，台上亮着问号灯
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands behind a quiz desk with a glowing question-mark lamp and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 安全知识问答，今天读懂接触限值。
overlay: 安全知识问答：读懂职业接触限值

shots.scene: 四张空白卡片排成一行，每张上面一个时间图标
shots.prompt_en: Four blank cards in a row, each with a different icon: a calendar of many years, a clock, an hourglass, and a red alarm bell. No people.
shots.narration: 四个英文缩写，其实一点不难。

shots.scene: 阿杰盯着说明书上的空白表格，挠头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stares at a blank table in a data sheet at his bench and scratches his head, wearing a lab coat and safety glasses.
shots.narration: 阿杰在说明书里看到一串缩写。

shots.scene: 阿杰转头问小研，小研笑着走过来
shots.prompt_en: The young male student turns to ask the female graduate student, who walks over smiling.
shots.narration: 这些数字，到底是什么意思？

shots.scene: 小研指着通风柜，又指指说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at a running fume hood, then at the blank data sheet.
shots.narration: 它们说的是：空气里有多少才算多。

shots.scene: 欣欣在问答台前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the quiz desk and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们一个一个来认识。

shots.section_title: 阈限值：一辈子接触的界线
shots.scene: 一条很长的时间轴，从年轻到退休的人形图标
shots.prompt_en: A long timeline with person pictograms from young to old walking along it, and a calendar icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第一个：阈限值。
overlay: 阈限值：一辈子接触的界线

shots.section_title: 阈限值：一辈子接触的界线
shots.scene: 空气中的有害物质小点，浓度线在虚线以下
shots.prompt_en: Small dots representing a hazardous substance floating in air, with a level line below a dashed limit line. No people.
shots.narration: 它是空气中有害物质的一个浓度界线。

shots.section_title: 阈限值：一辈子接触的界线
shots.scene: 一年年翻过的日历和健康的心形图标
shots.prompt_en: Calendar pages flipping year after year next to a healthy heart icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 在此之下，天天接触、干一辈子。

shots.section_title: 阈限值：一辈子接触的界线
shots.scene: 长期影响和短期影响两个图标都打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons, a long arrow and a short arrow, each with a green check mark beside a person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 大多数人长期短期都不受伤害。

shots.scene: 一天的时钟图标和一周日历，五天亮起
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon showing a workday next to a weekly calendar with five days highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 第二个：时间加权平均浓度。

shots.scene: 一天里高低起伏的浓度曲线，被拉平成一条虚线
shots.prompt_en: A wavy concentration line over a workday that is averaged into a flat dashed line. No people.
shots.narration: 把一天里高高低低的浓度，平均一下。

shots.scene: 平均线位于限值线以下，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The flat average line sits below a red limit line, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 按正常工时算，平均值不能超。

shots.scene: 小研在通风柜前做实验，旁边的平均线平稳
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works calmly at a fume hood, wearing a lab coat, gloves and safety glasses.
shots.narration: 不超这条线，正常工作不伤身体。

shots.scene: 空白数字牌被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A blank number plate crossed out with a red X next to a blank standards booklet. No people.
shots.narration: 具体数值，查国家标准，不靠背。

shots.scene: 沙漏图标和一段短尖峰
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass icon next to a line chart with one short spike. No people.
shots.narration: 第三个：短时间接触限值。

shots.scene: 阿杰倒溶剂的瞬间，浓度短暂升高
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pours a solvent inside a fume hood, and a small spike icon appears above the bottle.
shots.narration: 倒试剂、开瓶时，浓度会短暂冒高。

shots.scene: 尖峰被一条红线压住，旁边沙漏
shots.prompt_en: The short spike stays under a red limit line, with an hourglass icon showing a short time. No people.
shots.narration: 短时间内的最高浓度，也有上限。

shots.scene: 平均线合格但尖峰超线，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A chart where the average line is fine but one spike crosses the red limit line, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 平均没超，尖峰超了，也不行。

shots.section_title: 立即威胁生命和健康的浓度
shots.scene: 红色警报铃和骷髅图标
shots.prompt_en: A red alarm bell icon next to a skull pictogram inside a red warning frame. No people.
shots.narration: 第四个：立即威胁生命和健康的浓度。
overlay: 立即威胁生命和健康的浓度

shots.section_title: 立即威胁生命和健康的浓度
shots.scene: 浓度条冲到最高的深红区
shots.prompt_en: A concentration bar filling up into a dark red zone at the top. No people.
shots.narration: 到这个浓度，一接触就可能致命。

shots.section_title: 立即威胁生命和健康的浓度
shots.scene: 小人图标向出口跑，背后是气体云
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram running toward an exit sign away from a dark gas cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 这样的环境，人不能在里面作业。

shots.section_title: 立即威胁生命和健康的浓度
shots.scene: 有人想冲进气体云救人，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person rushing into a dark gas cloud, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 也绝不能贸然冲进去。

shots.scene: 四个台阶，从低到高，分别放四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four steps rising from low to high, with a calendar, a clock, an hourglass and a red alarm bell on each step. No people.
shots.narration: 四个概念，像四级台阶。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着第一、二级台阶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the first two steps.
shots.narration: 前两个看长期和每天的平均。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着第三、四级台阶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the top two steps, the hourglass and the alarm bell.
shots.narration: 后两个看短时尖峰和立即危险。

shots.section_title: 国内用的三类接触限值
shots.scene: 空白国家标准文件，封面一个盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank national standards booklet with a shield icon on the cover. No people.
shots.narration: 在国内，我们看职业接触限值标准。
overlay: 国内用的三类接触限值

shots.section_title: 国内用的三类接触限值
shots.scene: 三张卡片：平均线、短尖峰、一条绝不能碰的红线
shots.prompt_en: Three cards: a flat average line, a short spike under a line, and a solid red ceiling line. No people.
shots.narration: 分三类：时间加权、短时间、最高容许。

shots.section_title: 国内用的三类接触限值
shots.scene: 第三张卡片上的红线被高亮
shots.prompt_en: The third card with the solid red ceiling line glows. No people.
shots.narration: 最高容许浓度，任何时候都不能超。

shots.section_title: 国内用的三类接触限值
shots.scene: 欣欣指向空白标准，旁边打叉的外文缩写卡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the blank national standards booklet; beside it a blank foreign card is set aside.
shots.narration: 国外缩写只作了解，以国标为准。

shots.scene: 限值线下方仍有小小的警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A red limit line with a small yellow warning triangle still visible below it. No people.
shots.narration: 低于限值，不等于绝对安全。

shots.scene: 孕妇和过敏人群的小人图标
shots.prompt_en: Person pictograms for a pregnant woman and a person sneezing, each with a small caution icon. No people.
shots.narration: 有人更敏感，需要额外保护。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔：消除、替代、工程、管理、防护
shots.prompt_en: An inverted pyramid divided into five blank levels, the top widest, with icons: crossed-out bottle, swap arrows, fume hood, clipboard, gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 能少用就少用，能换就换。

shots.scene: 阿杰把挥发性试剂放进通风柜操作
shots.prompt_en: The young male student moves an open solvent bottle into a fume hood and works with the sash lowered, wearing gloves and safety glasses.
shots.narration: 挥发性操作，放进通风柜。

shots.scene: 浓度箭头一路向下
shots.prompt_en: A concentration arrow pointing steadily downward to a low level. No people.
shots.narration: 接触越低越好，不是贴线就行。

shots.scene: 鼻子图标被打叉，旁边是检测仪图标
shots.prompt_en: A nose icon crossed out with a red X next to a handheld gas detector icon with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 浓度高不高，鼻子说了不算。

shots.scene: 老李在实验室墙上检查固定式气体报警器
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks a wall-mounted gas detector in a lab with a blank tablet.
shots.narration: 用有毒气体的房间，装报警器。

shots.scene: 老李给报警器做标定，贴空白合格签
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer calibrates the gas detector and attaches a blank inspection tag.
shots.narration: 报警器要定期检定，确保好用。

shots.scene: 王老师手持便携检测仪，旁边空白记录单
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a portable gas detector next to a blank record sheet on a clipboard.
shots.narration: 需要时请专业机构检测，留好记录。

shots.scene: 报警器亮红灯，小人沿箭头撤离
shots.prompt_en: The wall detector flashes red while person pictograms walk out along an evacuation arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 一报警，立刻停下，撤离报告。

shots.scene: 口罩、防毒面具、长管供气面罩三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a dust mask, a half-face respirator with cartridges, and a supplied-air full-face mask with a hose. No people.
shots.narration: 呼吸防护，不是随便戴个口罩。

shots.scene: 滤毒罐图标对应不同气体颜色块
shots.prompt_en: A respirator cartridge icon next to several blank colored blocks, with a matching arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 过滤式要选对滤毒罐，按时更换。

shots.scene: 缺氧环境中戴过滤式面具的小人，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram wearing a filter respirator inside a low-oxygen tank icon, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 缺氧或浓度极高，过滤式不管用。

shots.scene: 小研对着镜子检查面罩密合
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student adjusts a half-face respirator and checks the seal with both hands.
shots.narration: 戴前要培训，戴时检查密合。

shots.scene: 通风柜和面具图标，通风柜在前
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood icon placed in front of a respirator icon, with an arrow showing order. No people.
shots.narration: 先靠通风，防护用品是最后一道。

shots.scene: 医生给研究人员做体检的简笔图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple icon of a doctor examining a lab worker with a stethoscope. No people.
shots.narration: 长期接触有毒物质，要做健康检查。

shots.scene: 老周给小研看空白告知卡
shots.prompt_en: The older man shows the female graduate student a blank hazard notice card posted at the lab entrance.
shots.narration: 实验室有哪些危害，要如实告知。

shots.scene: 空白档案夹和日历图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank file folder and a calendar icon with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 上岗前、在岗期间、离岗时都要查。

shots.scene: 小研咳嗽，转身向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student coughs lightly and turns to report to the older man.
shots.narration: 身体不适，及时报告，及时就医。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现四级台阶图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside an icon of four rising steps.
shots.narration: 四个概念：长期、平均、短时、立即。

shots.scene: 国家标准文件图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank national standards booklet with three blank tabs. No people.
shots.narration: 国内以职业接触限值国家标准为准。

shots.scene: 检测仪、通风柜、面具三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a gas detector, a fume hood, and a respirator. No people.
shots.narration: 靠检测、靠通风，防护要选对。

shots.scene: 体检和告知卡图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a health check stethoscope and a blank notice card. No people.
shots.narration: 健康检查和危害告知，一样不能少。

shots.scene: 欣欣在问答台后挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye from behind the quiz desk with the question-mark lamp.
shots.narration: 数值查标准，安全靠行动，再见！
